atoms.b: because she is confused about which way to go.

atoms.a: She stays in bed all morning and doesn’t answer her phone
atoms.b: because she feels sad about her best friend moving away.

atoms.a: She is smiling and spreading a positive energy everywhere today
atoms.b: because she is very happy about her new job.

atoms.a: His plane takes off very early tomorrow, but he can’t fall asleep
atoms.b: because he feels so excited about the trip.

atoms.a: He walks out of the room and slams the door
atoms.b: because he feels angry about losing the game.

atoms.a: He has no plan today and he seems bored
atoms.b: because all of his friends are busy.

atoms.sound: I swim every week and I am very good. Before the race, I stand at the edge of the pool and I look at the other swimmers. They look very fast and almost all of them have more experience than me. I feel that my hands are sweating a little and I feel under pressure.

atoms.a: How does Mei feel before the race?
atoms.sound: How does May feel before the race?

I take a deep breath and think about all my training. When the whistle blows, I dive in and I don’t think about anything or anyone else. I just focus on how well I swim. I know there is no reason to doubt myself.

atoms.a: How does Mei feel during the race?
atoms.sound: How does May feel during the race?

It’s a Saturday afternoon. I’m in my room and I go online, but nothing feels interesting. There’s nothing good to watch, and all my friends are busy. I can’t find anything fun to do! So, I decide to go into the garden to get some fresh air.

atoms.a: How does Ana feel before going into the garden?

atoms.sound: When I walk into the garden, suddenly everyone shouts “Happy Birthday!”. I see my cousin in the group. He lives in another country, so I feel so happy to see him there. I just freeze and stare at them for a moment. I can’t believe my eyes!

atoms.a: How does Ana feel after going into the garden?

atoms.sound: My cat runs up a tree and she doesn’t come down. I stand under the tree and call her name again and again. My hands shake a little and my stomach feels strange. I keep thinking about what is going to happen to her. What if something bad happens to her up there?!

atoms.a: How does Noor feel when her cat climbs up a tree?
atoms.sound: How does Norr feel when her cat climbs up a tree?

My neighbour calls the fire brigade, and they come with a big fire engine. Then the firefighter climbs up the tree and comes down with my cat in his arms. I take her home with me, and she sits on my lap. My shoulders drop, I close my eyes and I breathe slowly. Everything is good again, and I have no worries anymore.

atoms.a: How does Noor feel when she takes her cat back home?
atoms.sound: How does Norr feel when she takes her cat back home?
